notes.title: Our new game "Psycho-Sleuth" is here!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for your continued support of our team.
We’re excited to share some new news with you—our latest title, [i]PSYCHO-SLEUTH[/i], now has its official Steam page live![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432860"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]PSYCHO-SLEUTH[/i] is a mystery adventure game filled with supernatural abilities, dark secrets, and psychological conflict.
Set within an inescapable religious ritual, 13 characters with unique mental disorders and supernatural powers become entangled in a deadly game of truth and deception.
Will you uncover the hidden truths behind the afflicted, or be consumed by lies...?[/p][p]Thank you again for being with us—we look forward to seeing you in the world of [i]PSYCHO-SLEUTH[/i]!
[/p]

notes.title: Project: AHNO's Ark Unveiled on Steam Page!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are the PHOSEPO team.

After nearly two years of development, we are excited to officially unveil our latest game, "PROJECT: AHNO'S ARK" to all players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571328/30b1b042a8e680980c5d4aafe7f33ec7e413a6c9.png[/img]

"Reversed Ark Project: AHNO's Ark" is a turn-based strategy game with unique rules.

Each battle within the game lasts approximately 5-8 minutes, focusing on fast-paced consecutive battles. It also features Roguelite elements and introduces an innovative "Execution" concept based on the strategy game genre.

For those players who interested, we welcome you to wishlist our game and stay tuned for the latest updates on our page!

notes.title: 1.0.7 Released
notes.content:
In our earlier update, we added lyrics to the ending theme video for END 0 and adjusted the resolution to support more operating systems.
Also, we have made a few minor corrections to some of the text and performances.
If you encounter any problems, please let us know in the comments.
Thanks again to all the players who supported and gave feedback to "Rail of Mobius" in the first place.
